scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for finite positive-length metric stars; exact rational checks complement but do not prove the general result. Equilateral Banach-endpoint constants are known and not claimed as new. Optimization is restricted to positive effective conductances; some sharp infima require a singular limiting choice.
scientific_limitations: Finite real scalar metric stars only
Positive effective conductances; degenerating infimum may be unattained
No theorem for nonlinear or signed extension operators, infinite stars, or alternate physical-conductivity conventions
Independent historical verification of uniqueness is unavailable
title: Sharp conductance design for Lipschitz-harmonic extension on metric stars
